biocs.name: Suspicious rundll32.exe Injection
biocs.description: Detection of rundll32.exe being invoked with suspicious parameters indicating injection behavior
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'rundll32.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'C:\Windows\Temp\malware.exe'
